new file mode 100644
index 0000000..43a2067
--- /dev/null
+++ b/taxq/exemptions.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Registry 4 — the product categories a region zero-rates."""
+
+EXEMPT = {
+    "US-CA": (),
+    "US-NY": ("clothing",),
+    "EU-DE": ("books",),
+    "UK": ("books", "childrenswear"),
+}
+
+
+def exempt(region, category):
+    return category in EXEMPT.get(region, ())
diff --git a/taxq/filing.py b/taxq/filing.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9501d1e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/taxq/filing.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Registry 3 — how often we file in a region."""
+
+PERIODS = {
+    "US-CA": "quarterly",
+    "US-NY": "quarterly",
+    "EU-DE": "monthly",
+    "UK": "quarterly",
+}
+
+
+def period(region):
+    return PERIODS.get(region)
diff --git a/taxq/labels.py b/taxq/labels.py

--- /dev/null
+++ b/taxq/labels.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Registry 2 — what the tax line is called on the invoice."""
+
+LABELS = {
+    "US-CA": "CA Sales Tax",
+    "US-NY": "NY Sales Tax",
+    "EU-DE": "USt.",
+    "UK": "VAT",
+}
+
+
+def label(region):
+    return LABELS.get(region, "")

+++ b/taxq/rates.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Registry 1 — the rate, in basis points."""
+
+RATES = {
+    "US-CA": 725,
+    "US-NY": 887,
+    "EU-DE": 1900,
+    "UK": 2000,
+}
+
+
+def basis_points(region):
+    return RATES.get(region, 0)
prompt:
Our first two Irish orders were quoted at zero tax. EU-IE opened last month and
checkout accepts it, so the orders went through at the wrong price and finance
has had to re-issue both.

`docs/regions.md` says what opening a region actually takes. Please finish it.

`python run.py` must complete and every number in the run has to be the one a
live region gives.

Do not change `data/orders.json` and do not change the report's line shapes —
the finance close parses them.
